title: The Sleeping Old Lilly
subject: English Language
objectives: Read and understand a story about friendship
Learn the value of honesty and kindness

blocks.alt: Two old men sitting outside a hut
blocks.caption: Mark and Lilly have been friends for many years.

blocks.md:
**Mark** and **Lilly** have lived in the same street for over **thirty years**. They are now **seventy** years old.

One day, there was a heavy rain in the village. Mark thought his friend Lilly had gone to the farm. He rushed out in the rain to find him. But Lilly was actually at home, enjoying his sleep!

Mark shouted, *'Lilly, where are you?'* so loudly that all the villagers ran out, thinking there was a flood.

The noise woke Lilly up. He was angry and said he had gone to heaven in his sleep and was talking to God.

The villagers were also angry because Lilly had caused so much trouble for nothing.
**The Lesson:** Think before you act. Don't cause trouble for others without checking first.

quiz.q: How long have Mark and Lilly lived on the same street?
quiz.explain: The story says over thirty years.

quiz.q: Why did Mark run out in the rain?
options: To find Lilly at the farm
quiz.explain: He thought Lilly was at the farm.

quiz.q: Where was Lilly when Mark was looking for him?
quiz.explain: Lilly had been at home, sleeping.
